paperInfo.subject: English Literature
paperInfo.curriculum: ZIMSEC Advanced Level / Heritage-Based Curriculum-aligned practice
paperInfo.copyrightNote: Original practice questions synthesized from syllabus and examination structure; not verbatim copies of copyrighted past papers.
paperInfo.sourceBasis: ZIMSEC syllabus/specimen resources and publicly accessible examination-pattern references.

questions.questionText: Zimbabwean Literature — Zimbabwean poetry: Write a critical essay examining this issue in one or more prescribed Zimbabwean texts. Develop an argument, support it with textual evidence, analyse the writer's methods, and evaluate the significance of the issue within Zimbabwean historical, cultural and social contexts.
questions.explanation: Answers should be text-centred and analytical, with accurate evidence, discussion of writer's methods, contextual awareness and a justified conclusion.
